name: offsetwp/twig-wordpress-extension
description: The functions of WordPress in Twig: {{ the_permalink() }}, {{ wp_head() }}, and fn() for every other one

suggest.offsetwp/twig-bundle: Registers this extension in an OffsetWP kernel with one line of configuration

scripts-descriptions.lint: Check the coding standard over src and tests.
scripts-descriptions.lint:fix: Fix every coding-standard violation that can be fixed automatically.
scripts-descriptions.stan: Run the static analyser over src and tests.
scripts-descriptions.test: Run the unit, integration and usage suites.
scripts-descriptions.ci: Run the coding standard, the static analyser and the test suites, in that order.
